description.en: Aseprite-style pixel art studio: the AI draws sprites stroke by stroke with selections, layers, animation frames, gradients, symmetry and reference layers, each step rendered live as ANSI terminal frames.
description.zh: Aseprite 风格像素画工作室：AI 逐笔绘制精灵图，支持选区、图层、动画帧、渐变、对称与参考图层，每一步以 ANSI 终端帧实时渲染。
